title: The US OCC conditionally approves a bank charter application for Trump family's World Liberty Financial, allowing it to directly issue its USD1 stablecoin (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: The US OCC conditionally approves a bank charter application for Trump family's World Liberty Financial, allowing it to directly issue its USD1 stablecoin — A national U.S. bank regulator on Friday conditionally approved a bank charter application linked to President Donald Trump …
